scientific_integrity: The formulas are derived from Lie automorphism blocks, Jordan-module centralizers, and finite general-linear derangement counts. Finite enumeration is supplementary, not an infinite proof. Existing structural results are explicitly acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: For nonzero finite-dimensional V and invertible T with split characteristic polynomial over the coefficient finite field; excludes zero eigenvalues and nonsplit primary components. All arbitrary-field facts used are proved or credited; independent mathematical certification has not occurred.
title: Exact fixed-point-free automorphism counts for split-Jordan almost-abelian Lie algebras
